releasePlan.notes: Roles: enable-backend-status-error-rate = killswitch; enable-backend-status-latency = pause; enable-backend-status-success-rate = monitoring. The error and success metrics are ONE-ARMED by construction — control renders no backend-status line, so only the v1 audience can emit them. Latency is two-armed: the page handler's server-side render duration is tracked on both variations. The project has no otel* autogenerated metrics, and the existing sentry-errors-* metrics are fed by the Flask backend's Sentry init, which this frontend-scoped flag can never emit into, so they were considered and rejected as guardrails.
